character_system_text.1106:10000: I always thought I was a pretty realistic person, you know. And yet I got swept right up into this amazing world.
character_system_text.1106:10001: Whenever I listen to you, Trainer, I can tell you're hyping me up... but it's a little late to complain now, huh?
character_system_text.1106:10002: I sometimes wonder if it's okay for us to be this laid-back... Though honestly, I kinda love this vibe.
character_system_text.1106:10003: New Year's is for taking it easy, obviously. Eat, sleep, watch TV, scroll on my phone... That's the proper etiquette.
character_system_text.1106:10004: You're expecting you-know-what, aren't you? Of course you are. Well, um... I guess I did prepare something... Hehe.
character_system_text.1106:10005: Homemade chocolate is surprisingly exhausting to make, y'know. So, um... please enjoy it with lots of gratitude!
character_system_text.1106:10006: Tanabata's all about wishes, but if you ask for too much, you'll get punished, right? Hmm... then, a bigger allowance!
character_system_text.1106:10007: With limited-edition Halloween snacks, you can't rush. The pros, like me, go for the leftovers.
character_system_text.1106:10008: "Sorry, I've got plans for Christmas..." I'd love to say that with a smug look someday.
character_system_text.1106:10009: Oooh, I love Christmas decorations and the whole vibe around town. Wanna go soak it all in together?
character_system_text.1106:10010: Another year's almost over... I gotta set my recorder for all the TV specials that look fun.
character_system_text.1106:10011: I remember, you know. It's your birthday, right? Hehe, wanna grab some extra-big sushi from the supermarket?
character_system_text.1106:10012: Happy birthdaaay! Actually, I may have already reserved a cake with your name on it. ...Ahaha.
character_system_text.1106:10013: I want a birthday party! With those ring thingies hung on the wall... Huh? What're those called again...?
character_system_text.1106:10014: So, guess what day it is today. ...Hehe, it's my once-a-year Miracle Day. My birthday! Yaaay.
character_system_text.1106:10015: Oh? There's a notice. ...Wouldn't it be nice if it said I won a sweepstakes?
character_system_text.1106:10016: Ooh, a present's here. Yay, yay.
character_system_text.1106:10017: Mission clear, complete~ Hehehe, that sounded kinda like a video game.
character_system_text.1106:10018: Ooh, an event, an event. That makes me kinda antsy.
character_system_text.1106:10019: Ah, the event's already started! I wonder if there are okonomiyaki stalls?
character_system_text.1106:10025: The denim frills were kind of an adventure for me personally... but it all comes together safely enough. Yup, yup.
character_system_text.1106:10026: I totally lost to the shop clerk's "It looks great on you!" sales pitch. But hey, getting complimented just works on me.
character_system_text.1106:10027: I went out for okonomiyaki with friends and got sauce on my collar... Color-wise, that's safe, right? ...It's safe, right?
character_system_text.1106:20000: Aah... I'm totally in the mood for a cushion dive right now.
character_system_text.1106:20001: This is bad... I'm not in any condition to try hard...
character_system_text.1106:20002: Maybe it's 'cause you're always flattering me... I'm feeling super, super motivated today.
character_system_text.1106:20003: Whoa, what is this?! I'm feeling weirdly miraculous today... I mean, Miracle IS my actual name.
character_system_text.1106:20004: Alrighty, plenty of motivation. Guess it's a good day for hard work.
character_system_text.1106:20005: Okay, I'm all fired up today. ...Just don't expect too much, okay? Ahaha.
character_system_text.1106:20006: Heyy. I kinda got changed and kinda warmed up. Same old me as always.
character_system_text.1106:20007: Today I'm feeling, like, really average. That's all I've got to say. ...Ahaha.
character_system_text.1106:20008: Hmm, I'm not that motivated... And if someone who's always like this says it out loud, it's pretty serious.
character_system_text.1106:20009: Well, this is just how I normally am... But, ugh, I've got goals. I've gotta try hard, huh...
character_system_text.1106:20010: ...Ah... Oh no. I've been thinking about this lukewarm jet bath at a hot spring I went to ages ago... the whole time...
character_system_text.1106:20011: Ugh... I can't. Even if you flatter me... I just don't feel like I can move.
character_system_text.1106:20021: I've been running a liiittle too much... You know I'm not the stoic type, right?
character_system_text.1106:20022: Waaah, somebody help... My hot-blooded demon trainer is bullying meee...!
character_system_text.1106:20023: If someone interviewed me right now, I feel like I'd say something super ambitious... That's the mood I'm in!
character_system_text.1106:20024: My hidden power awakens at last! ...Okay, I've been reading too much manga, but I really do feel good!
character_system_text.1106:20025: Don't I look kinda different? I'm in such great shape, it wouldn't be weird if I had an aura!
character_system_text.1106:20026: Huh? Could I actually win this?! ...I said that like it was someone else's problem. Ahaha.
character_system_text.1106:20027: This isn't really like me. Somehow... I feel just a little bit confident!
character_system_text.1106:20028: You're so good at flattering me, Trainer. ...Thanks to you, I'm in good shape.
character_system_text.1106:20029: I'm feeling super normal. Right before the race... is that actually a good thing?
character_system_text.1106:20030: If I can just be my usual self, that's good enough... right?
character_system_text.1106:20031: I did warm up a bit, but my heart's still pounding... It's the real thing, huh...
character_system_text.1106:20032: My prep didn't go great, but hey, that's life... What am I even saying? Ahaha.
character_system_text.1106:20033: Whatever happens, happens. But I'll show what I've worked for. Even me.
character_system_text.1106:20034: Whether you laugh or cry, the moment of truth arrives... Just like a test you didn't study for...
character_system_text.1106:20035: ...I tried to say something positive, but only negative stuff keeps popping up... Nnngh...
character_system_text.1106:20036: I'm just not feeling it... Let's think about something convenient... Hot springs if I win, a feast if I win...
character_system_text.1106:20037: If I win in this state, I'll seriously think I'm amazing... but that'd be a little too miraculous.
character_system_text.1106:20050: You really took good care of me.
character_system_text.1106:30000: Second?! I got second! I, I did it... Yeah!
character_system_text.1106:30001: That's a pretty good placement, right?!
character_system_text.1106:60000: I'll write "Umamusume" on my palm and swallow it!
character_system_text.1106:60001: So many people... Ugh, this is bad.
character_system_text.1106:70001: You were really good at hyping me up, Trainer... Wha?! That's a compliment! Honest!
character_system_text.1106:90000: Ow ow... When I wake up groggy, I roll around on the floor a bit, but today I kinda overdid it...
character_system_text.1106:90001: Made it just in time. See, I woke up early and went to school with time to spare... but apparently that was a dream.
character_system_text.1106:90002: For lunch I should really eat fish and veggies with lots of amino acids... but nooo, I want something sweet!
character_system_text.1106:90003: That sauce smell...?! Is this... okonomiyaki? ...No, it's yakisoba. It's not sweet enough...
character_system_text.1106:90004: Want me to give you a shiatsu massage after work? I know a liiittle bit about relaxing pressure points.
character_system_text.1106:90005: You look tired. Hmm, shall I tell you my top three favorite hot spring inns I've been to?
character_system_text.1106:90006: Cherry blossom season is the best! Napping buried in petals, enjoying the scent of sakura... Mmm, perfect!
character_system_text.1106:90007: Summer means the beach! ...But I'm bad at swimming... I'm bad at breathing, too, and I end up snorting water...
character_system_text.1106:90008: Autumn's the season of sports. In fall, my family used to hold meetings about whether to go watch G1 races or soccer.
character_system_text.1106:90009: When it's this cold, you never wanna leave your futon... Isn't there a way to walk around wearing it?
character_system_text.1106:91000: I looked up what Gimlet was talking about, and it was Norse mythology? The Übermensch? Now I'm even more lost...
character_system_text.1106:91001: Kris S is really good at staring contests. I've lost every time so far, but I hope I can make her laugh someday.
character_system_text.1106:91002: I play soccer with Fine and the others sometimes, and her attendants are super good at defense.
character_system_text.1106:91003: Top Road's soccer sense is seriously amazing. Sometimes I wonder if she's a pro.
character_system_text.1106:91004: The perfect day off is going to a furniture store! Trying out beds and sofas makes the day fly by.
character_system_text.1106:91005: I know it's a costume, but sometimes I get all rational about it... like, I kinda want to cover my tummy...
character_system_text.1106:91006: I always get confused with fan service... I worry whether they're really waving at me.
character_system_text.1106:91007: This racing outfit is really comfy. The belt's elastic, so it fits super loose.
character_system_text.1106:91008: Shoes in different colors, a tiny diamond... Ehehe, they make me feel a little special. I love them.
character_system_text.1106:91009: I need some time to zone out in the morning. I like watching the ceiling get brighter from my futon.
character_system_text.1106:91010: After lunch I'm totally useless... The notes I take in the afternoon mostly turn into wiggly worms.
character_system_text.1106:91011: The trick to sleeping well is putting a drop of aroma oil on a towel by your pillow. The nice smell helps you sleep.
character_system_text.1106:91012: Warm sunny days are nice. The turf on the course feels like a fancy carpet, so running feels great.
character_system_text.1106:91013: So hooot... I can't relax even on a nice sofa, and I get hot even doing nothing... Ugh...
character_system_text.1106:91014: Rating the fallen-leaf carpet: the sink and the fit are top-notch... but you get dirty, so 70 points!
character_system_text.1106:91015: Snow huts are great. Light an aroma candle and you can relax wrapped in the glow.
character_system_text.1106:92000: I slept like a log, so I'm more motivated than usual! ...Than usual, yes.
character_system_text.1106:92001: I'm ready whenever. Hill runs, weights... Ah, but nothing too hard, please...
character_system_text.1106:92002: Okaaay, I'll do my best. It's training time, after all. Well, as much as I can...
character_system_text.1106:92003: Training, huh... Hmm... Yeah, I guess... Depends on what we're doing.
character_system_text.1106:92011: Pretty beaches are nice, huh. ...That's not me hinting I wanna do beach dashes. I'm assuming we're chilling.
character_system_text.1106:92005: Well, when you believe in me like that... it does make me wanna try as hard as I can.
character_system_text.1106:92006: If I could become someone people proudly say they're cheering for... that'd make me happy. Yeah.
character_system_text.1106:92007: I used to just wish for miracles, but now, if I try hard, maybe I can make one... Hmm, if I try REALLY hard...?!
character_system_text.1106:93000: So you were my miracle all along.
character_system_text.1106:93001: We made a miracle happen together, didn't we?
character_system_text.1106:95000: Maybe I can try a little harder?
character_system_text.1106:95001: Huh, did I just break through a wall...?
character_system_text.1106:95003: I'm Hishi Miracle. I'll do my best... in moderation.
character_system_text.1106:95004: Even if you expect that much, I'm just average!
character_system_text.1106:1008: Guess I'll just give it my best!
character_system_text.1106:40000: I'll do my best, in my own way!
character_system_text.1106:40001: I'm nowhere near the class star who's great at studying and sports... just an average girl... but, nngh, I'll do my best!
character_system_text.1106:30004: I won?! No way?! I... I did it!
character_system_text.1106:110000: The important thing in training is to keep at it. ...That's the hardest part.
character_system_text.1106:110001: The academy's history, huh. I do kinda like TV documentaries.
character_system_text.1106:110002: Huh, are we entering a race? Uh-oh, warm-ups, warm-ups.
character_system_text.1106:10021: Oh, a report. Looks like your Umamusume Directory level went up.
character_system_text.1106:20051: Okay, nice to work with you.
character_system_text.1106:95005: Am I starting to look dependable?
character_system_text.1106:120000: Wh-what's this power...?! Is this even possible?!
character_system_text.1106:140005: Well, well, that's how it goes.
character_system_text.1106:70004: When you think of youth, it's gotta be uniforms. Yup.
character_system_text.1106:70010: To be clear, I did NOT pick the academy for its uniform!
character_system_text.1106:70008: I think I look a little more glamorous now.
character_system_text.1106:70014: Performing center in this... Ugh, that takes guts.
character_system_text.1106:70009: I'm happy but also kinda overwhelmed... Whoa, what is this feeling?
character_system_text.1106:70015: Actually, even the soles of the boots have a special pattern.
character_system_text.1106:71004: When you think of youth, it's gotta be uniforms. Yup.
character_system_text.1106:71010: To be clear, I did NOT pick the academy for its uniform!
character_system_text.1106:71008: I think I look a little more glamorous now.
character_system_text.1106:71014: Performing center in this... Ugh, that takes guts.
character_system_text.1106:71009: I'm happy but also kinda overwhelmed... Whoa, what is this feeling?
character_system_text.1106:71015: Actually, even the soles of the boots have a special pattern.
character_system_text.1106:2031: Guess I'll just give it my best!
character_system_text.1106:2032: You really took good care of me.
character_system_text.1106:2033: You're so good at flattering me, Trainer. ...Thanks to you, I'm in good shape.
character_system_text.1106:2034: Don't I look kinda different? I'm in such great shape, it wouldn't be weird if I had an aura!
character_system_text.1106:2035: You really took good care of me.
character_system_text.1106:90010: Ku-chan's early-riser challenge! Today's result...? Dantsu had to wake me up. Teehee.
character_system_text.1106:90011: For once I didn't fall back asleep, and I even tied up my hair! Wow, a miracle! Hehe♪
character_system_text.1106:90012: You get a little peckish around now, huh. ...Actually, if you tap this pocket, cookies come out—? There were some a minute ago.
character_system_text.1106:90013: Freedom from class, a tasty lunch... Ahh, bliss. ...Huh? Pool training this afternoon?
character_system_text.1106:90014: Here it is, the best time of the day! A bath, manga, lazing around in bed... Perfect!
character_system_text.1106:90015: Ugh. I'm tired. So tired. I'll just dive into bed... Ack. The assignment I put off is due tomorrow...!
character_system_text.1106:90016: Mmm. So warm and breezy~ Spring feels kinda like an open-air bath, doesn't it... Zzz.
character_system_text.1106:90017: Th-this is bad. I've been wearing loose clothes this whole time, so my swimsuit... I mean, it fits! It does, but...
character_system_text.1106:90018: It's autumn before you know it. ...Wanna set up a kotatsu in the trainer's office soon? Wanna?
character_system_text.1106:90019: Ugh, so dry again today. Gotta crank up the humidifier... But honestly, what a pain.
character_system_text.1106:91016: Durandal and Gimlet have such wild vocabularies... Are they reading the same manga or something?
character_system_text.1106:91017: Waking up at 6 a.m. to Light O's footsteps, then going back to sleep. That's my golden combo on days off.
character_system_text.1106:91018: ...Dantsu, I get it. Having intense classmates is rough. Let's just chill and drink tea in our room.
character_system_text.1106:91019: Watching Miracle-chan, don't you just get the urge to toss her into a hot spring? Like, "Just rest already!"
character_system_text.1106:91020: Apparently "donburiko" in the acorn song means falling into water with a splash... Kris S sure studies hard.
character_system_text.1106:91028: Clothes. When I go shopping alone, I always end up picking similar stuff. Doesn't that happen to you too, Trainer?
character_system_text.1106:91029: The highlight of this outfit is the "singing old man brooch" on the chest! I love stuff that's just the right kind of weird.
character_system_text.1106:91021: Ah-ah-ah. Ahem! Ahh~♪ ...Phew, winning live practice. Please let me not mess up the lyrics today.
character_system_text.1106:91022: Today's live practice was incredible, too. Everyone in class sings so well. Am I really allowed to watch for free? Right?
character_system_text.1106:91023: Hmm hmm hmm hmm, hmm hmm hmm♪ ...Ehehe. Did you see the stars outside? They were so pretty I wanted to sing.
character_system_text.1106:91024: There's no dress code for cherry blossom viewing... right? It's an invite from Fine... Ugh, I can't mess this up...
character_system_text.1106:91025: I can't stand the heat, sure, but I can't stand the AC being too strong either. Glad I brought a cardigan.
character_system_text.1106:91026: Sweet potatoes, hmm hmm♪ Chestnuts, pumpkins! Hmm hmm♪ Autumn's so nice, so yummy~♪
character_system_text.1106:91027: I agonize over a 1,000-yen lunch, but I'll buy 1,500-yen warm socks without a second thought. That's me, Hishi Miracle!
character_system_text.1106:92015: I changed my hairstyle, too, so let's take it nice and easy.
character_system_text.1106:92016: Huh?! You're making a cheer song for me?! Wh-what...? I-I'm happy, but isn't that way too embarrassing?
character_system_text.1106:92017: M-maybe it's 'cause my earmuffs are wool? I can't hear very well. ...Did you just say we're going all out?
character_system_text.1106:92018: Since I'm all dressed up... after training, wanna go to our usual okonomiyaki place?
character_system_text.1106:92020: This outfit is super cute, but... with my average aura, will people even think I'm an active racer?
character_system_text.1106:92021: I-is it just me? Lately people keep coming up to say they're my fans... Could it be... the fashion effect?!
character_system_text.1106:92022: It's not the fashion effect or a miracle... They're expecting things from us, aren't they? Everyone... from you and me.
character_system_text.1106:93004: Our harmony of hard work really rang out!
character_system_text.1106:93005: Ehehe... I'm in a good mood. Shall we sing?
character_system_text.1106:95007: Hehe, wanna go for one more song?
character_system_text.1106:95008: The harmony of sweat and tears is now in full bloom! ...Just kidding.
character_system_text.1106:95010: Ah-ah♪ Oh, yes! It's Hishi Miracle.
character_system_text.1106:70016: Clothes you bought with friends are "special" just because of that, right?
character_system_text.1106:70017: I can feel my braids swaying~
character_system_text.1106:71016: Clothes you bought with friends are "special" just because of that, right?
character_system_text.1106:71017: I can feel my braids swaying~
character_system_text.1106:95009: Not a little autumn, but a little miracle! ...Wanna go find one?
character_system_text.1106:40003: Even if it's small, it's still a miracle!
character_system_text.1106:40004: Now, now. Relax your shoulders once in a while! Take it eeasy... Oh! Hehe... Here's a miracle for you♪
character_system_text.1106:30006: Wh-whoa?! I did it! Do I get a reward?!
character_system_text.1106:70018: I'm kind of the type who tries things on. Not that it matters.
character_system_text.1106:70019: Huh? Is it fraying...? Nope. Phew.
character_system_text.1106:71018: I'm kind of the type who tries things on. Not that it matters.
character_system_text.1106:71019: Huh? Is it fraying...? Nope. Phew.
character_system_text.1106:81000: You're picking me? You've got weird taste.
character_system_text.1106:81001: You're totally fired up. ...Guess I'll catch some of that!
character_system_text.1106:400005: Stuff like this is actually pretty fun once you do it. Best of all, it eats up class time! Ehehe♪
character_system_text.1106:400011: I'm totally gonna be sore tomorrow! But I think it was a good memory, right? The afterparty was fun♪
character_system_text.1106:400001: I did choir back in elementary school... but I've forgotten everything I learned! Sorry, music teacher...
character_system_text.1106:400006: All my friends were like, "Mira-ko snapped?! That's rare!" ...Ugh, I'm thinking the same thing about myself.
character_system_text.1106:400009: No being lazy—I'll get it dry-cleaned properly when the seasons change! ...I want to take good care of this outfit.
character_system_text.1106:70020: These are just my normal hanging-out clothes.
